BoxManip_SelectHint: Select an action on the left. Nothing changes until you select Apply.
BoxManip_ImpactDelete: {0} of {1} occupied slots in scope will be deleted.
BoxManip_DoneUndo: {0}: {1} slots changed. Use Edit > Undo to revert the whole operation.
BoxManip_DestructiveWarning: This deletes Pokémon. You must confirm before it runs.
BoxManip_UndoHint: Each applied action is one step in Edit > Undo.
BoxManip_Desc_DeleteAll: Removes every Pokémon in the scope.
BoxManip_Desc_DeletePastGen: Removes Pokémon whose origin generation differs from this game's generation.
BoxManip_Desc_DeleteForeign: Removes Pokémon whose original trainer is not this save's trainer.
BoxManip_Desc_DeleteUntrained: Removes Pokémon with no effort values (Legends: Arceus: without maximum effort levels).
BoxManip_Desc_DeleteItemless: Removes Pokémon that hold no item.
BoxManip_Desc_DeleteIllegal: Removes Pokémon that fail the legality check.
BoxManip_Desc_DeleteClones: Keeps the first copy of each identical Pokémon and removes later copies. The count is known only after it runs.
BoxManip_Desc_SortSpecies: Orders by National Pokédex number, lowest first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortSpeciesReverse: Orders by National Pokédex number, highest first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortDate: Orders by the date each Pokémon was met (Gen 2: by time of day met).
BoxManip_Desc_SortName: Orders alphabetically by species name in the current language.
BoxManip_Desc_SortFavorite: Moves Pokémon marked as favorite to the front.
BoxManip_Desc_SortParty: Moves Pokémon that are in the party to the front (Let's Go).
BoxManip_Desc_SortShiny: Moves shiny Pokémon to the front.
BoxManip_Desc_SortAlpha: Moves alpha Pokémon to the front.
BoxManip_Desc_SortRandom: Places the Pokémon in random order.
BoxManip_Desc_SortUsage: Orders by how much friendship each Pokémon gained since it was obtained, most first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortPotential: Orders by the sum of individual values, highest first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortTraining: Orders by the sum of effort values, highest first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortOwner: Puts this save's own Pokémon first, then groups the rest by original trainer.
BoxManip_Desc_SortType: Orders by primary type, then secondary type.
BoxManip_Desc_SortVersion: Orders by origin generation, game, then met location.
BoxManip_Desc_SortBST: Orders by the species' base stat total, lowest first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortCP: Orders by combat power, lowest first (Let's Go).
BoxManip_Desc_SortScale: Orders by size scale, smallest first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortRibbons: Orders by number of ribbons, most first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortMarks: Orders by number of marks, most first.
BoxManip_Desc_SortLegal: Moves Pokémon that pass the legality check to the front.
BoxManip_Desc_SortEncounterType: Orders alphabetically by the name of the matched encounter.
BoxManip_Desc_ModifyHatchEggs: Hatches every egg as if it hatched in this save.
BoxManip_Desc_ModifyResetMoves: Replaces the moves with the suggested legal moveset.
BoxManip_Desc_ModifyRandomMoves: Replaces the moves with a random legal moveset.
BoxManip_Desc_ModifyHyperTrain: Hyper Trains the stats that the legality rules allow.
BoxManip_Desc_ModifyGanbaru: Sets the suggested effort levels (Legends: Arceus).
BoxManip_Desc_ModifyRemoveNicknames: Resets each nickname to the species name.
BoxManip_Desc_ModifyRemoveItem: Removes the held item from every Pokémon.
